items.t: 60 houses sold in Killarney, Vancouver at a median of $1,840,000 (middle half $1,647,000 to $2,075,000). A typical house in Killarney, Vancouver spent 18 days on the market and closed at 96.0% of the asking price.

In Killarney, Vancouver, townhomes sold at a median of $796,000 across 12 sales, and the middle half closed between $753,750 and $1,002,500. The median townhome sat 18 days and sold for 96.0% of list.
Killarney, Vancouver: 28 duplexes sold at a median of $1,450,000, with the middle half between $1,283,500 and $1,546,083. The median duplex took 28 days to sell and closed at 95.4% of list.

blocks.text: 4 Condos also sold in Killarney, Vancouver, too few for a median to mean anything, so no price is shown for them.
Source: Paragon closed sales, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026; medians need 5 or more sales.
How Killarney compares with the rest of Vancouver East

items.t: Houses in Killarney have the 5th highest median of 15 Vancouver East sub-areas, $1,840,000. Collingwood is lowest at $1,510,000 and Fraser highest at $1,980,000. Mount Pleasant VE ($1,835,000) sits just below and Grandview-Woodland ($1,900,000) sits just above.
Townhomes in Killarney have the lowest median of the 13 Vancouver East sub-areas, $796,000, below Strathcona at $898,500; the highest is Main at $1,419,500.

Duplexes in Killarney have the 8th highest median of 15 Vancouver East sub-areas, $1,450,000. Strathcona is lowest at $1,112,500 and Main highest at $1,919,000. Hastings ($1,420,000) sits just below and Victoria VE ($1,450,000) sits just above.

blocks.text: By build year, duplexes are the newest homes selling in Killarney, Vancouver (median 2025) and townhomes the oldest (median 1973), a gap of 52 years.
